info.title: RFQ API
info.description:
Moment's RFQ API is a modern platform for algorithmic fixed income trading, for placing, retrieving, and updating Requests For Quote (RFQ).

For complete documentation on the RFQ API and to obtain your keys head to https://withmoment.com/docs/api-documentation/api-v1/. Once you have your keys, head to the environments tab to quickly get started.

RFQQuoteResponseStatus.description: The status of the quote response.

Price.description: The price of the RFQ represented as a percentage of par.

SpreadPrice.description: The spread price of the RFQ represented as a percentage of par.

type.description: The size of an RFQ, with a specified type indicating how the size is represented. Par sizes represent the size of the RFQ in face value; most corporate bonds have a face value of $1000, so an order with par $3000 would represent an order for 3 bonds. Notional sizes represent the size of the RFQ in current dollar value, so an RFQ with notional $3000 would represent an RFQ to buy or sell $3000 worth of the bond at the current market prices. Currently, only `par` sizes are supported.

Side.description:
Represents which side this RFQ is on:
- buy (offers wanted)
- sell (bids wanted)

VenueMPID.description: The Market Participant Identifier (MPID) of the venue.

CounterType.description:
The current status of the counter.
quoted: original quoted price
initiated: counter offer initiated by the client
negotiated: counter offer negotiated by dealer to client

CounterHistory.description: History of counter offers for an RFQ quote response.

created_at.description: The time at which the counter was created in RFC-3339 format.

expires_at.description: The time at which the counter expires in RFC-3339 format.

price.description: The price of the counter offer represented as a percentage of par.

price_value.description: An object to represent the price value. This can be a percent price, spread price, discount yield, money market yield.

quote_response_id.description: The ID of the quote response this counter is associated with.

settlement_date.description: The settlement date of the counter quote as a Unix timestamp.

venue_price_type.description: The type of price used by the venue for this quote.

PriceValueType.description: The method used to represent the price value.
PriceValueType.title: Price Value Type
